component_title: Employment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi
component_subtitle:
This indicator measures the employment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Employment rate: It represent persons in employment as a percentage of the population of working age (15- 64 years)

security.label: Open
security.name: 0 - Open
security.description: Data that is authorized for direct access without restrictions.

policy_guide: 1 - The above data reflects a quarterly labor force survey (according to the used methodology) that counts all persons who are 15+ and are usual residents of the emirate, regardless of where they work.

2 - The Statistics Center - Abu Dhabi is currently working on the procedure of updating the time series statistics, to comply with the results of the 2023 Census, and the updated time series of these statistics will be published after the completion of this procedure to ensure accuracy and reliability.

3 - The forecasts produced for the reference period are generated using historical data collected prior to the start of the reference period. Therefore, any activities or policies that may have contributed to changes in values during the forecasted period are not considered in these projections.

metaData.label: Indicator description
metaData.value: This indicator measures the employment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi  Employment rate: It represent persons in employment as a percentage of the population of working age (15- 64 years)

metaData.label: Statistical population
metaData.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metaData.label: Geographic coverage
metaData.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.
